page.overview:
Who is Richard K. Berman?

Richard K. Berman was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. He was a Starfleet Command flag officer with the rank of commodore in 2364.

On stardate 41734.4, he sent an order about the Romulan Neutral Zone patrol schedule to Commander Samuel Freedle of Starbase Trailer Twenty-Nine. (, okudagram)
